body:
Hi @zackify,

Can you add a [jsfiddle](https://jsfiddle.net/vvoyer/ar80rgpc/2/) illustrating how you do it? 

Also can you[ run this recipe](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/tree/v2/packages/react-instantsearch/examples/geo-search) and tell me if the behaviour works for you? 
Basically each time you click on the map, you'll see the search state being updated with the new coordinates from the map (and by extension it will appear on the url).
